title: How I work
subtitle: Agile and framework-agnostic: we deliver step by step, leaving room for learning and changing insights. I work closely with the teams in place, and bring in a trusted network of senior specialists when additional capacity or expertise is required.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Understand the real problem: stakeholders, constraints, risks and the current system. Map what matters and what doesn't.

steps.title: Define
steps.text: Turn insight into direction: a clear problem statement, success metrics, scope boundaries, and a delivery plan.

steps.title: Develop
steps.text: Explore solution options and validate fast. Prototype where useful, then implement in small, working increments.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Production-grade outcomes: ship, operate, document, and transfer. You end up with a system your team can run and evolve.
